name: Progress Bar
description: Horizontal progress bar with percentage display. On mobile, displays as a circular progress indicator. Percentage is shown as a tooltip on hover (desktop) or in the label (mobile).

structure.html:
{PERCENTAGE}
{LABEL_TEXT}

PERCENTAGE.description: Progress percentage (e.g., '29%' or '100%'). Used for both width and data-percentage attribute.

LABEL_TEXT.description: Text displayed next to the progress bar (e.g., '2/7' for '2 of 7 subtopics').

TOOLTIP_TEXT.description: Tooltip text shown on hover (desktop). Usually describes the progress (e.g., '2 of 7 subtopics').

renderedHtml:
29%
2/7
features: Circular progress indicator on mobile (automatic via CSS)
Label text next to progress bar
notes: The percentage text inside the progress bar is hidden on desktop (shown as tooltip) but visible on mobile. The data-percentage attribute is required for the tooltip to work. On mobile, the progress bar automatically becomes circular (16px diameter) via CSS media queries.
